name: fix_flaky_tests
title: Reproduce -> Diagnose -> Fix Flaky Tests
description: Scan a test suite for flaky tests, produce a task_list.v1 of reproducers/fixes, and fix each flaky test in parallel with verification.

inputs.name: suite
inputs.description: Test suite or package path to scan for flakes

inputs.name: test_command
inputs.description: Test command to reproduce and verify flaky tests

inputs.name: verify_cmd
inputs.description: Command to verify the test suite passes reliably

brief.goal: Identify flaky tests in {{inputs.suite}} (using {{inputs.test_command}}), determine root causes, and emit a task_list.v1 of isolated fixes.
acceptance: Structured task_list.v1 listing each flaky test with root-cause goal and verification command
Flake eliminated and test passes deterministically

brief.goal: Run the full suite verification for {{inputs.suite}} after all flake fixes.
acceptance: Suite verification command exits 0 without flakes
